lean.statement: theorem sub_eq_zero_l : ∀ a b : R, rR.add a (rR.opp b) = rR.zero → a = b := by
lean.proof:
intro a b h
  have h' : rR.add (rR.add a (rR.opp b)) b = rR.add rR.zero b := by
    simpa using congrArg (fun t : R => rR.add t b) h
  -- rewrite using the ring axioms, following the Coq script
  have := h'
  -- (a + (-b)) + b = a + ((-b) + b) by assoc; then = a + 0 = a; RHS: 0 + b = b
  -- We'll perform the same steps explicitly:
  -- Left:
  have L1 : rR.add (rR.add a (rR.opp b)) b = rR.add a (rR.add (rR.opp b) b) := by
    simpa using (rR.add_assoc a (rR.opp b) b)
  have L2 : rR.add (rR.opp b) b = rR.zero := by
    calc
      rR.add (rR.opp b) b = rR.add b (rR.opp b) := by simpa using (rR.add_comm (rR.opp b) b)
      _ = rR.zero := by simpa using (rR.add_opp b)
  have L3 : rR.add a (rR.add (rR.opp b) b) = rR.add a rR.zero := by simp [L2]
  have L4 : rR.add a rR.zero = a := rR.add_zero a
  -- Right:
  have R1 : rR.add rR.zero b = b := by
    calc
      rR.add rR.zero b = rR.add b rR.zero := by simpa using (rR.add_comm rR.zero b)
      _ = b := by simpa using (rR.add_zero b)
  -- Put together:
  have : a = b := by
    simpa [L1, L2, L3, L4, R1] using h'
  exact this

coq.statement: Lemma sub_eq_zero_l `{ring R} : forall a b, a -R b = zero -> a = b.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros a b H2.
    assert (H': (a +R opp b) +R b = zero +R b).
    {
      rewrite H2.
      reflexivity.
    }
    rewrite add_assoc in H'.
    rewrite add_comm with (x:=opp b) (y:=b) in H'.
    rewrite add_opp in H'.
    rewrite add_zero in H'.
    rewrite add_comm, add_zero in H'.
    exact H'.
  Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem root_factor
  (degree : polynomial → mynat)
  (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial)
  (eval : polynomial → R → R)
  (p : polynomial) (a : R) :
  is_root eval a p → ∃ q : polynomial, p = rP.mul q (X_minus monomial a)
:= by
lean.proof:
intro hp
  --
  rcases (euclid_X_minus (degree := degree) (monomial := monomial) p a) with
    ⟨q, r, h_eq, h_deg⟩
  -- Show `eval r a = 0`
  have hr0 : eval r a = rR.zero := by
    -- rewrite the evaluation of the decomposition at `a`
    have hsum : eval (rP.add (rP.mul q (X_minus monomial a)) r) a = rR.zero := by
      simpa [h_eq] using hp
    -- first, use eval_add to split the sum
    have hsum' : rR.add (eval (rP.mul q (X_minus monomial a)) a) (eval r a) = rR.zero := by
      simpa [eval_add] using hsum
    -- then, expand the product
    have hmul : eval (rP.mul q (X_minus monomial a)) a
                  = rR.mul (eval q a) (eval (X_minus monomial a) a) := by
      simp [eval_mul]
    have : rR.add (rR.mul (eval q a) (eval (X_minus monomial a) a)) (eval r a) = rR.zero := by
      simpa [hmul] using hsum'
    -- compute eval of X_minus and simplify
    have hx : eval (X_minus monomial a) a = rR.add a (rR.opp a) := by
      simp [X_minus, eval_add, eval_X, eval_C]
    have : rR.add (rR.mul (eval q a) (rR.add a (rR.opp a))) (eval r a) = rR.zero := by
      simpa [hx] using this
    have : rR.add (rR.mul (eval q a) rR.zero) (eval r a) = rR.zero := by
      simpa [rR.add_opp] using this
    have : rR.add rR.zero (eval r a) = rR.zero := by
      simpa [rR.mul_zero] using this
    have : rR.add (eval r a) rR.zero = rR.zero := by
      simpa [rR.add_comm] using this
    simpa [rR.add_zero] using this
  -- `r` is constant
  rcases (deg_constant (degree := degree) (monomial := monomial) r).mp h_deg with ⟨c, hc⟩
  subst hc
  -- From `eval (C c) a = 0`, we get `c = 0`
  have : c = rR.zero := by
    simpa [eval_C] using hr0
  subst this
  -- Conclude
  have : p = rP.mul q (X_minus monomial a) := by
    simpa [C_zero, rP.add_zero] using h_eq
  exact ⟨q, this⟩

coq.statement:
Lemma root_factor :
    forall p a, eval p a = zero ->
      exists q, p = q *R X_minus a.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros p a Hp.
    destruct (euclid_X_minus p a) as (q & r & Heq & Hdr).

    assert (eval r a = zero).
    {
      rewrite Heq in Hp.
      rewrite (eval_add (q *R X_minus a) r a) in Hp.
      rewrite (eval_mul q (X_minus a) a)      in Hp.
      unfold X_minus in Hp.
      rewrite (eval_add X (C (-R a)) a)        in Hp.
      rewrite (eval_X a)                      in Hp.
      rewrite (eval_C (-R a) a)               in Hp.
      rewrite add_opp     in Hp.
      rewrite mul_zero    in Hp.
      rewrite add_comm, add_zero in Hp.
      assumption.
    }
    destruct (proj1 (deg_constant r) Hdr) as (c & Hr_eq).
    subst r.
    rewrite eval_C in H1.
    subst c.
    rewrite C_zero in Heq.
    rewrite add_zero in Heq.
    now exists q.
  Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem root_transfer
  (degree : polynomial → mynat)
  (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial)
  (eval : polynomial → R → R)
  (p q : polynomial) (a b : R) :
  p = rP.mul q (X_minus monomial a) →
  b ≠ a →
  is_root eval b p →
  is_root eval b q
:= by
lean.proof:
intro hp hba hpb
  -- Evaluate at `b` and use no-zero-divisors
  have := hpb
  have hb0 :
    eval (rP.mul q (X_minus monomial a)) b = rR.zero := by
    simpa [hp] using hpb
  have : rR.mul (eval q b) (eval (X_minus monomial a) b) = rR.zero := by
    simpa [eval_mul] using hb0
  -- compute eval of X_minus at b
  have hx : eval (X_minus monomial a) b
              = rR.add b (rR.opp a) := by
    simp [X_minus, eval_add, eval_X, eval_C]
  -- no zero divisors
  have h' := rR.no_zero_div (eval q b) (b -R a) (by simpa [hx] using this)
  rcases h' with hq | hba'
  · exact hq
  · have : b = a := sub_eq_zero_l (a := b) (b := a) hba'
    exact (hba this).elim

coq.statement:
Lemma root_transfer :
    forall p q a b,
      p = q *R X_minus a ->
      b <> a ->
      eval p b = zero ->
      eval q b = zero.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros p q a b Hp Hba Hb.
    rewrite Hp in Hb.
    rewrite eval_mul in Hb.
    unfold X_minus in Hb.
    rewrite !eval_add, eval_X, eval_C in Hb.
    apply no_zero_div in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [Hq | Hba'].
    - exact Hq.
    - apply sub_eq_zero_l in Hba'.
      congruence.
  Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem roots_le_degree
  (degree : polynomial → mynat)
  (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial)
  (eval : polynomial → R → R)
  (p : polynomial) (xs : mylist R) :
  NoDupL xs →
  (∀ a, InL a xs → is_root eval a p) →
  p ≠ rP.zero →
  mynat_le (lengthL xs) (degree p)
:= by
lean.proof:
intro hnd hrt hp0
  -- Stronger statement with explicit generalization over p
  have main : ∀ (xs : mylist R), NoDupL xs →
      ∀ (p : polynomial), (∀ a, InL a xs → is_root eval a p) → p ≠ rP.zero →
      mynat_le (lengthL xs) (degree p) := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nilL =>
        intro _ p _ _
        simpa using mynat_zero_le (degree p)
    | consL a xs ih =>
        intro hnd_xs p hrt' hp0'
        -- a is a root
        have ha : is_root eval a p :=
          hrt' a (InL.In_head xs)
        -- factor p = q * (X - a)
        rcases root_factor degree monomial eval p a ha with ⟨q, hpq⟩
        -- destruct NoDup for a ::L xs
        cases hnd_xs with
        | ND_cons _ _ hnotin hnd_tl =>
            -- q ≠ 0
            have qnz : q ≠ rP.zero := by
              intro h
              have hq0 : rP.mul q (X_minus monomial a) = rP.zero := by
                simp [h, rP.mul_comm, rP.mul_zero]
              have : p = rP.zero := by simp [hpq, hq0]
              exact hp0' this
            -- X_minus a ≠ 0
            have xnz : (X_minus monomial a) ≠ rP.zero := by
              intro h
              have hx0 : rP.mul q (X_minus monomial a) = rP.zero := by
                simp [h, rP.mul_zero]
              have : p = rP.zero := by simp [hpq, hx0]
              exact hp0' this
            -- degree computation
            have hdeg : degree p = S (degree q) := by
              have := (deg_mul (degree := degree)
                          (p := q) (q := X_minus monomial a)) qnz xnz
              -- degree p = degree q + degree (X - a) = degree q + 1
              -- normalize to S (degree q)
              simpa [hpq, deg_X_minus, mynat_add_comm, mynat_add_zero_r, mynat_add_S_r] using this
            -- reduce to xs, using root transfer
            have hF : ∀ b, InL b xs → is_root eval b q := by
              intro b hb
              -- b ≠ a
              have hba : b ≠ a := by
                intro hbaeq; subst hbaeq
                exact hnotin hb
              -- b is root of p
              have hbroot : is_root eval b p :=
                hrt' b (InL.In_tail (y := a) (xs := xs) hb)
              -- transfer
              exact root_transfer degree monomial eval p q a b hpq hba hbroot
            -- conclude by IH on q and xs
            have ihRes := ih hnd_tl q hF qnz
            -- rewrite degree p = S (degree q) and length of cons
            simpa [hdeg, lengthL] using mynat_succ_le_succ ihRes
  -- apply main to the original inputs
  exact main xs hnd p hrt hp0

coq.statement:
Theorem roots_le_degree :
    forall p (xs:mylist R),
      NoDupL xs ->
      (forall a, InL a xs -> root a p) ->
      p <> zero ->
      mynat_le (lengthL xs) (degree p).
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros p xs Hnd Hrt Hnz.
    revert p Hrt Hnz.
    induction xs as [|a xs IH]; intros p Hrt Hnz.
    - simpl. apply mynat_zero_le.
    - simpl in *. 
      assert (Ha : root a p) by (apply Hrt; constructor).
      destruct (root_factor p a Ha) as [q Hpq].
      inversion Hnd as [| x0 xs0 Hnotin Hnd_xs]; subst x0 xs0; clear Hnd.
      assert (q <> zero) as qnz.
      { 
        intro G.
        rewrite G in Hpq.
        rewrite mul_comm in Hpq.
        rewrite mul_zero in Hpq.
        exact (Hnz Hpq).
      }
      assert (X_minus a <> zero) as xnz.
      { 
        intro G.
        rewrite G in Hpq.
        rewrite mul_zero in Hpq.
        exact (Hnz Hpq).
      }
      assert (Hdeg : degree p = S (degree q)).
      { 
        rewrite Hpq.
        rewrite (deg_mul q (X_minus a) qnz xnz).
        rewrite deg_X_minus.
        rewrite mynat_add_comm.
        reflexivity. 
      }
      rewrite Hdeg.
      apply mynat_succ_le_succ.
      assert (Hf : forall b, InL b xs -> root b q).
      { 
        intros b Hb.
        apply (root_transfer p q a b Hpq).
        - intro Heq; subst b; apply Hnotin; assumption.
        - apply Hrt; constructor 2; assumption.
      }
      apply IH; auto.

  Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem X_minus_nonzero
  (degree : polynomial → mynat)
  (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial) :
  ∀ a, (X_minus monomial a) ≠ rP.zero := by
lean.proof:
intro a h
  have hdeg : degree (X_minus monomial a) = S O :=
    deg_X_minus (degree := degree) (monomial := monomial) a
  have : degree rP.zero = S O := by simpa [h] using hdeg
  have : O = S O := by simp [deg_zero] at this
  cases this

coq.statement: Lemma X_minus_nonzero : forall a, X_minus a <> zero.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros a Ha.
    specialize (deg_X_minus a) as Hdeg.
    rewrite Ha in Hdeg.
    rewrite deg_zero in Hdeg.
    discriminate Hdeg.
  Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem constant_root_zero
  (degree : polynomial → mynat)
  (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial)
  (eval : polynomial → R → R)
  (p : polynomial) (a : R) :
  degree p = O → is_root eval a p → p = rP.zero := by
lean.proof:
intro hdeg hroot
  rcases (deg_constant (degree := degree) (monomial := monomial) p).mp hdeg with ⟨c, hc⟩
  subst hc
  have : c = rR.zero := by simpa [is_root, eval_C] using hroot
  subst this
  simp [C_zero]

coq.statement:
Lemma constant_root_zero :
    forall p a, degree p = O -> root a p -> p = zero.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros p a Hdeg Hroot.
    destruct (proj1 (deg_constant p) Hdeg) as [c Hpc].
    subst p.
    unfold root in Hroot; rewrite eval_C in Hroot.
    subst c.
    rewrite C_zero; reflexivity.
  Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem root_of_product
  (eval : polynomial → R → R)
  (p q : polynomial) (a : R) :
  is_root eval a (rP.mul p q) → is_root eval a p ∨ is_root eval a q := by
lean.proof:
intro hpq
  have : rR.mul (eval p a) (eval q a) = rR.zero := by simpa [is_root, eval_mul] using hpq
  simpa [is_root] using rR.no_zero_div (eval p a) (eval q a) this

coq.statement:
Lemma root_of_product :
    forall p q a, root a (p *R q) -> root a p / root a q.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros p q a Hpq.
    unfold root in *; rewrite eval_mul in Hpq.
    apply no_zero_div in Hpq; tauto.
  Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem root_scale_constant
  (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial)
  (eval : polynomial → R → R)
  (p : polynomial) (c a : R) :
  c ≠ rR.zero → (is_root eval a p ↔ is_root eval a (rP.mul (C monomial c) p)) := by
lean.proof:
intro hc
  constructor
  · intro hp
    -- Expand and rewrite explicitly to avoid unused-simp warnings
    -- eval ((C c) * p) a = c * eval p a = c * 0 = 0
    have hpa0 : eval p a = rR.zero := hp
    have : rR.mul c (eval p a) = rR.zero := by
      simp [hpa0, rR.mul_zero]
    simpa [is_root, eval_mul, eval_C] using this
  · intro hcp
    have hz : rR.mul c (eval p a) = rR.zero := by
      simpa [is_root, eval_mul, eval_C] using hcp
    have hdisj : c = rR.zero ∨ eval p a = rR.zero := rR.no_zero_div c (eval p a) hz
    cases hdisj with
    | inl hcz => exact (hc hcz).elim
    | inr hp0 => simpa [is_root] using hp0

coq.statement:
Lemma root_scale_constant :
    forall p c a, c <> zero -> (root a p <-> root a (C c *R p)).
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros p c a Hc.
    split.
    - intros Hp; unfold root in *.
      rewrite eval_mul, eval_C, Hp, mul_zero; reflexivity.
    - intros Hcp; unfold root in *.
      rewrite eval_mul, eval_C in Hcp.
      apply no_zero_div in Hcp; tauto.
  Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem poly_of_roots_nonzero
  (degree : polynomial → mynat)
  (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial) :
  ∀ (xs : mylist R), poly_of_roots monomial xs ≠ rP.zero
| mylist.nilL => rP.one_neq_zero
| mylist.consL a xs =>
    by
lean.proof:
intro h
      -- (X - a) * poly_of_roots xs = 0 ⇒ one factor = 0
      have := rP.no_zero_div (X_minus monomial a) (poly_of_roots monomial xs) h
      rcases this with hx | hxs
      · exact (X_minus_nonzero (degree := degree) (monomial := monomial) a) hx
      · exact (poly_of_roots_nonzero (degree := degree) (monomial := monomial) xs) hxs

coq.statement: Lemma poly_of_roots_nonzero : forall xs, poly_of_roots xs <> zero.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    induction xs as [|a xs IH]; simpl.
    - exact one_neq_zero.
    - intro Ha; apply no_zero_div in Ha; destruct Ha as [Ha|Ha]; 
        [apply X_minus_nonzero in Ha | apply IH in Ha]; contradiction.
  Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem deg_poly_of_roots
  (xs : mylist R) :
  degree (poly_of_roots monomial xs) = lengthL xs := by
lean.proof:
induction xs with
  | nilL =>
      calc
        degree (poly_of_roots monomial mylist.nilL)
            = degree rP.one := by simp [poly_of_roots]
        _   = degree (C monomial rR.one) := by simp [C_one]
        _   = O := by simp [deg_C, rR.one_neq_zero]
  | consL a xs ih =>
      have hx : (X_minus monomial a) ≠ rP.zero :=
        X_minus_nonzero (degree := degree) (monomial := monomial) a
      have hp : (poly_of_roots monomial xs) ≠ rP.zero :=
        poly_of_roots_nonzero (degree := degree) (monomial := monomial) xs
      have hmul :
          degree (poly_of_roots monomial (mylist.consL a xs))
            = mynat_add (degree (X_minus monomial a))
                        (degree (poly_of_roots monomial xs)) := by
        simpa [poly_of_roots] using
          (deg_mul (degree := degree)
            (p := X_minus monomial a) (q := poly_of_roots monomial xs) hx hp)

      have hxdeg : degree (X_minus monomial a) = S O :=
        deg_X_minus (degree := degree) (monomial := monomial) a

      have hstep :
          degree (poly_of_roots monomial (mylist.consL a xs))
            = S (degree (poly_of_roots monomial xs)) := by
        simpa [hxdeg, mynat_add_comm, mynat_add_S_r, mynat_add_zero_r] using hmul

      simpa [lengthL, hstep] using congrArg S ih

Lemma deg_poly_of_roots :
    forall xs, degree (poly_of_roots xs) = lengthL xs.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    induction xs as [|a xs IH]; simpl.
    - rewrite <- C_one, deg_C; [reflexivity|exact one_neq_zero].
    - pose proof (X_minus_nonzero a) as Hx.
      pose proof (poly_of_roots_nonzero xs) as Hp.
      rewrite deg_mul; try assumption.
      rewrite deg_X_minus, IH.
      rewrite mynat_add_comm.
      rewrite mynat_add_S_r, mynat_add_zero_r.
      reflexivity.
  Qed.

theorem root_factor_list
  (degree : polynomial → mynat)
  (monomial : mynat → R → polynomial)
  (eval : polynomial → R → R) :
  ∀ (p : polynomial) (xs : mylist R),
    NoDupL xs →
    (∀ a, InL a xs → is_root eval a p) →
    ∃ q, p = rP.mul q (poly_of_roots monomial xs)
:= by
lean.proof:
intro p xs; revert p
  induction xs with
  | nilL =>
      intro p _ _
      exact ⟨p, by simp [poly_of_roots, rP.mul_one]⟩
  | consL a xs ih =>
      intro p hnd hroots

      cases hnd with
      | ND_cons _ _ hnotin hnd' =>

          have Ha : InL a (a ::L xs) := InL.In_head xs
          have hroot_pa : is_root eval a p := hroots a Ha
          rcases root_factor (degree := degree) (monomial := monomial) (eval := eval) p a hroot_pa with ⟨q, hpq⟩

          have Hq : ∀ b, InL b xs → is_root eval b q := by
            intro b hb
            have hba : b ≠ a := by
              intro hbaeq; subst hbaeq; exact hnotin hb
            have hbroot : is_root eval b p := hroots b (InL.In_tail (y := a) (xs := xs) hb)
            exact root_transfer (degree := degree) (monomial := monomial) (eval := eval)
              p q a b hpq hba hbroot

          rcases ih q hnd' Hq with ⟨q0, hq0⟩
          refine ⟨q0, ?_⟩



          calc
            p = rP.mul q (X_minus monomial a) := by simp [hpq]
            _ = rP.mul (rP.mul q0 (poly_of_roots monomial xs)) (X_minus monomial a) := by
                  simp [hq0]
            _ = rP.mul q0 (rP.mul (poly_of_roots monomial xs) (X_minus monomial a)) := by
                  simp [rP.mul_assoc]
            _ = rP.mul q0 (rP.mul (X_minus monomial a) (poly_of_roots monomial xs)) := by
                  simp [rP.mul_comm]

Lemma root_factor_list :
  forall p xs,
    NoDupL xs ->
    (forall a, InL a xs -> root a p) ->
    exists q, p = q *R poly_of_roots xs.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros p xs.
    induction xs as [| a xs IH] in p |- *.
    - exists p; simpl; rewrite mul_one; reflexivity.
    - intros Hnd Hroots.
    inversion Hnd as [| a' xs' Hnotin Hnd']; subst a' xs'.
    assert (Ha : InL a (a ::L xs)) by constructor.
    pose proof (Hroots a Ha) as Hroot_pa.
    destruct (root_factor p a Hroot_pa) as [q Hpq].
    assert (Hroots_q : forall b, InL b xs -> root b q).
    {
      intros b Hb.
      assert (Hba : b <> a) by (intro E; subst b; apply Hnotin; assumption).
      pose proof (Hroots b (In_tail b a xs Hb)) as Hroot_b.
      eapply root_transfer; eauto.
    }
    destruct (IH q Hnd' Hroots_q) as [q0 Hq0].
    exists q0.
    simpl. rewrite Hpq. rewrite Hq0. rewrite mul_assoc.
    rewrite (mul_comm (poly_of_roots xs) (X_minus a)).
    reflexivity.
  Qed.

theorem degree_factorisation :

    p = rP.mul q (poly_of_roots monomial xs) →
    q ≠ rP.zero →
    degree p = mynat_add (degree q) (lengthL xs)

intro p xs q hp hq
  have hz : poly_of_roots monomial xs ≠ rP.zero :=
    poly_of_roots_nonzero (degree := degree) (monomial := monomial) xs
  simp [hp,
         (deg_mul (degree := degree) _ _ hq hz),

Lemma degree_factorisation :
    forall p xs q,
      p = q *R poly_of_roots xs ->
      q <> zero ->
      degree p = mynat_add (degree q) (lengthL xs).

Proof.
    intros p xs q Hp Hq.
    rewrite Hp.
    rewrite deg_mul; try assumption; try apply poly_of_roots_nonzero.
